title: 第25章 哭哭也算时间第26章 赐名花绮罗
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
陆鸣说的那句“站住”
只是看女子想跑所以下意识的开口。
可没想到一句话竟然将女子定在了原地，陆鸣自己心里也是微微一惊。
还真是言出法随啊？
我这领域也太给力了吧！
但他面上依旧保持着那副高深莫测的模样，继续一步步走向女子的同时哼笑道：“我让你走了吗？”
“你当我烟霞峰是想来就来，想走就走的地方吗？”
女子看着距离自己越走越近的陆鸣，整个人汗毛倒竖，脊背发凉。
“别过来！”
“我让你别过来，站住！”
“给本座站住！”
她虽然身体不能动，但体内兽核尚能运转！
即便被陆鸣定住，但她也不是轻易的束手就擒之人。
虽然对方的实力高强，但如有一线之机就理应破釜沉舟！
只要让这人做出防御动作，兴许这道禁锢就会消散，而她也就有了逃命的机会！
如此想着，女子眼眸之中的恐惧收敛，狠狠咬牙，猛地催动兽核。
嗡！
兽核迅速运作，下一秒，一股夹杂着毒雾的灵气团直射陆鸣面门！
然而，面对这一击，陆鸣甚至连眼睛都没眨一下。
那团灵气在距离他咫尺之遥时，瞬间消散。

“什么？！”
女子眼眸一缩，瞳孔地震，她根本就没看到陆鸣做了什么。
只觉灵气向着陆鸣轰去后就莫名其妙消散了！
女子头皮都发麻了。
她修炼千年，所见过最强的修士不过是元婴境。
可那些元婴境的修士根本做不到如此诡异的抵挡灵气。
而且这已经不是抵挡灵气了。
这是直接让攻击失效！
这不是化神境大佬是什么！
她一个金丹境，遇上化神境就相当于蝼蚁遇到上古巨兽啊！
就在女子惊愕无比时，陆鸣已经走到了她的面前。
“你……你要干什么？”
content_en:
Lu Ming said "stop"
I just saw that the woman wanted to run away, so I spoke subconsciously.
Unexpectedly, one word would freeze the woman in place, and Lu Ming himself was slightly shocked.
Are you really following your words?
I’m so good in this field!
But he still maintained that enigmatic look on his face. He continued to walk towards the woman step by step and said with a smile: "Did I let you go?"
"Do you think that Yanxia Peak is a place where you can come and leave whenever you want?"
The woman looked at Lu Ming, who was getting closer and closer to her, with the hair on her body standing on end and a chill running down her spine.
"Don't come here!"
"I told you not to come over, stop!"
"Stop for me!"
Although she can't move her body, the beast core in her body can still function!
Even though she was immobilized by Lu Ming, she was not someone who could be easily captured.
Although the opponent is very powerful, if there is a chance, he should go all out!
As long as this person makes defensive movements, maybe this restriction will dissipate and she will have a chance to escape!
Thinking of this, the fear in the woman's eyes converged, she gritted her teeth and violently activated the beast's core.
Buzz!
The beast core operated quickly, and in the next second, a ball of spiritual energy mixed with poisonous mist shot directly at Lu Ming's face!
However, facing this blow, Lu Ming didn't even blink.
The group of spiritual energy dissipated instantly when it was just a few feet away from him.
"What?!"
The woman's eyes narrowed and her pupils were shaking. She didn't even see what Lu Ming did.
I felt the spiritual energy roar towards Lu Ming and then dissipate inexplicably!
The woman's scalp was numb.
She has been practicing for thousands of years, and the strongest monk she has ever seen is only in the Nascent Soul realm.
But those monks in the Nascent Soul Realm are simply unable to resist such strange spiritual energy.
And this is no longer about resisting spiritual energy.
This directly invalidates the attack!
This is not what a big boss in the realm of gods is!
She is in the Golden Core Realm, and meeting the God Transformation Realm is like an ant meeting an ancient behemoth!
Just when the woman was in shock, Lu Ming had already walked in front of her.
"You...what are you going to do?"
